Senses.Explanation: Transmit the robe and entrust the law joins two succession acts. One address distinguishes the period when both were transmitted from the post-Huineng transmission of the law without the robe; historical notices recount the earlier succession. The phrase is a paired succession formula; the records themselves distinguish robe-transfer from law-transfer.
